strategyDescription: Sublinear TF-IDF vectors over PR titles and bodies (URLs, HTML comments, and blockquotes stripped; terms in fewer than two or more than half of PRs dropped), then bottom-up average-linkage merging by cosine similarity until no pair reaches 0.12. No model calls; cluster labels are top-weighted terms.
noveltyRationale: Prior runs used GitHub labels, keyword/scope rules, or hand-written cluster membership (two runs hard-coded PR numbers; one simulated execution). This design computes assignments from text statistics with no hand-written membership and no model calls, so the clustering method and evidence representation differ from the keyword-rule approach.
